answer: Mechanism: escrowed maturity bonds. Each identity posts a fee held as a crystal, a deposit receipt bound to its key and registration timestamp. The contract accrues one maturity unit per epoch onto an append-only thread of signed receipts; the crystal refunds after 64 clean epochs, a slash voids it. Age reads from the chain's record, so re-registrations restart at zero: attackers cannot reset what they must grow. N puppets each lock their own fee for the full window, so cost grows linearly in n; honest users pay once. Slashed crystals fund the ocean pool paying auditors.
